ck_assessments_question_count.name: ck_assessments_question_count
ck_assessments_question_count.value:
(
      ("assessments"."kind" = 'diagnostic' and "assessments"."requested_question_count" between 10 and 20)
      or ("assessments"."kind" = 'post_test' and "assessments"."requested_question_count" between 5 and 10)
      or ("assessments"."kind" = 'card_quiz' and "assessments"."requested_question_count" is null)
    )

ck_assessment_scope.name: ck_assessment_scope
ck_assessment_scope.value:
(
      ("assessments"."kind" = 'diagnostic'
      and "assessments"."plan_id" is null
      and "assessments"."plan_node_id" is null
      and "assessments"."source_card_content_id" is null
    ) or (
      "assessments"."kind" = 'post_test'
      and "assessments"."plan_id" is null
      and "assessments"."plan_node_id" is not null
      and "assessments"."source_card_content_id" is not null
    ) or (
      "assessments"."kind" = 'card_quiz'
      and "assessments"."plan_node_id" is not null
      and "assessments"."source_card_content_id" is null
    ))

ck_content_chunks_embedding_metadata.name: ck_content_chunks_embedding_metadata
ck_content_chunks_embedding_metadata.value:
(
      "content_chunks"."embedding" is null
      and "content_chunks"."embedding_model" is null
      and "content_chunks"."embedding_version" is null
    ) or (
      "content_chunks"."embedding" is not null
      and "content_chunks"."embedding_model" is not null
      and "content_chunks"."embedding_version" is not null
    )
